{{TierBar}}


'''Adapted Parasites''' are a Tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. This Tier is placed above [[Primitive Parasites]] and contains 12 Mobs. Killing all of them at least once grants the player the {{AdvancementLink|Adapted}}.

Parasites part of the Adapted Tier must be approached with caution because of their particularly strong Stats and unique Abilities.

== ''Shared Aspects and Capabilities'' ==

=== Spawning ===
*Spawn after a [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive Parasite]] [[Evolution System|evolves]] after killing 30 mobs;
*Spawns naturally if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher;
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]].

=== Weakness ===
*Like all Parasites, Adapted present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled);
*Some of the Adapted Parasites present either a [[Adaptation System#Trivia|Weak Point]] or [[Adaptation System#Neutralization|Tendrils]]:
**When the first are hit, the damage inflicted to the Parasite is tripled. This also inflicts the [[Bleeding]] Effect to the Parasite;
**When the second are hit enough times, they'll be cut off, resetting the Parasites' [[Adaptation System|Adaptation]]. This also inflicts the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] Effects.

=== Capabilities ===
*Adapted Parasites are capable of regenerating when out of combat;
**Adapted Parasites obtain the Regeneration Effect after killing something. The Effect lasts enough to regenerate 1 HP;
*Adapted Parasites are capable of performing small leaps, both on land and in liquids, which grants them a movement advantage;
**Primitive Parasites are capable of jumping a certain amount of blocks, depending on the Parasite, in order to reach their targets. [[Adapted Arachnida|Arachnida]] and [[Adapted Longarms|Longarms]] are the only exception, because they are capable of climbing blocks;
*Adapted Parasites will escape from Lava and Magma Blocks after being damaged by them;
*Adapted Parasites inflict the [[Call Of The Hive]] Effect when attacking in Melee;
*Adapted Parasites are capable of puking [[Residue]] (as long as the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4), which has a chance to spawn Beckons;
*Adapted Parasites are capable of [[Adaptation System#Adaptation|adapting]] to Damage Types. The maximum number of Damage Types they can learn is 3;
**Adapted Parasites posses a Damage Cap of 3<ref>This means that, no matter how much Damage an Adapted is receiving, it'll always need at least three hits before going down</ref>;
**Adapted Parasites have a Minimum Damage of 1.5<ref>This means that, no matter how much Armor an Adapted's target is wearing, it will always take at least 1.25 damage.</ref>.

=== Griefing Capabilities ===
All Adapted can break blocks that have their [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Breaking#Blocks_by_hardness Hardness] Value up to 3<ref>Exception for Bolsters, which can break blocks that have their Hardness Value up to 3.5</ref>, with a 40 ticks cooldown and 1<ref>Exception for Manducaters, Yelloweyes, Arachnida and Bolsters, which have a 2 Blocks range.</ref>Block range.

After there's a certain amount of dropped items around, Adapted will spawn a [[Parasitic Cyst]], which will slowly clean these items.

=== Post-Death ===
*After dying, all Adapted have a chance to explode, releasing a Potion Cloud which inflicts the Poison and [[Call Of The Hive]] Effects. They will also leave behind [[Remains|Adapted Remains]];
*After dying, all Adapted have a chance to activate the [[Reinforcement System]].
{{Properties|tier=Adapted}}
Note: Each Adapted Parasites’ Orb gives an additional effect to either mobs, other parasites, or itself.  See their individual pages for more information.
